notes.title: Development Diary #5. Construction of the main room
notes.content:
Today I would like to share the construction of a complete room. The game will have several rooms available to the player for furnishing: the main room (bedroom), kitchen and bathroom. Perhaps with new updates, the possibility of expanding the player's apartment will be added.

Check this out:

[previewyoutube=tMaJXxdXnO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]***[/h1]
More cool development news coming soon! Good luck to all!
In the meantime, you can add the game to your wishlist or follow the development on my [url=https://twitter.com/ChillApartment]Twitter[/url].

tags.feature: - The game will have several rooms available to the player for furnishing: the main room (bedroom), kitchen and bathroom.

notes.title: Devlog Diary #3. Day & night cycle
notes.content:
Today I would like to share the progress of working on the day/night cycle in the game. The time in the game will be tied to your local time, but there will also be a feature to speed it up.

Check this out:

[previewyoutube=7gQsliOdkZ4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]***[/h1]
More cool new stuff about development, game play and features is coming soon! Cheers!
Meanwhile you can check my steam forums or follow my [url=https://twitter.com/ChillApartment]Twitter[/url].
